classification: all 44 design mapped; source contract/CI evidence only; no live host/security/DB/provider truth inferred

invariants.title: Learner hostname
invariants.frozen_requirement: lms.reltroner.com = learner/user frontend
invariants.future_test: Learner hostname resolves and Cloudflare Pages static journey smoke tests
invariants.audit_observation: Learner frontend source and FE CI exists; hostname DNS/browser smoke untested

invariants.title: Admin hostname
invariants.frozen_requirement: lms-admin.reltroner.com = admin frontend
invariants.future_test: Admin hostname isolated from learner and origin-level auth tests
invariants.audit_observation: Admin separate frontend origin is planned; no isolated admin deployment evidence

invariants.title: Public backend hostname
invariants.frozen_requirement: lms-api.reltroner.com = only public LMS backend/API entry point
invariants.future_test: Only lms-api public API ingress; no private service exposed via DNS/ports
invariants.audit_observation: Gateway hostname contract pinned; public port/ingress verification absent

invariants.title: Identity authority
invariants.frozen_requirement: auth.reltroner.com = canonical Reltroner OIDC/Keycloak authority
invariants.future_test: Live OIDC issuer/JWKS and audience negative claims verification
invariants.audit_observation: Issuer fixed in trust candidate; Keycloak issuer/JWKS live untested

invariants.title: Separate OIDC trust contexts
invariants.frozen_requirement: Learner and admin use separate OIDC client identities.
invariants.future_test: Two public OIDC clients code+PKCE exact origin/redirect and cross-client denial
invariants.audit_observation: Distinct lms-user/lms-admin + PKCE model; clients not proven provisioned

invariants.title: Frontend authorization is non-authoritative
invariants.frozen_requirement: UI state never grants privilege.
invariants.future_test: Missing or spoofed frontend roles cannot grant backend capability
invariants.audit_observation: Capabilities in BE model prevent UI persona promotion; server enforcement runtime absent

invariants.title: Server-side admin enforcement
invariants.frozen_requirement: All admin privilege is enforced server-side.
invariants.future_test: Admin routes require admin-client context, required capability and audited adapter
invariants.audit_observation: Admin route matrix 8 ops; no actual admin controller auth enforcement

invariants.title: Internal service privacy
invariants.frozen_requirement: Internal microservices are not publicly addressable.
invariants.future_test: Deny direct public access to all five non-Gateway service ingress paths
invariants.audit_observation: Private workload assertion model; no firewall/private ingress probes

invariants.title: Durable truth
invariants.frozen_requirement: PostgreSQL is the durable LMS business-state authority.
invariants.future_test: Durable writes in owned PG databases survive Redis loss and restart
invariants.audit_observation: Four PostgreSQL owned DB candidates; no durable domain DB transaction

invariants.title: Logical ownership
invariants.frozen_requirement: Each domain service owns its own logical data.
invariants.future_test: Domain database roles restrict access to own schema/database
invariants.audit_observation: Four owner/grant matrices; no database roles actually provisioned

invariants.title: No cross-service direct writes
invariants.frozen_requirement: No service may directly write another service's database.
invariants.future_test: Cross-service write credential negative suite
invariants.audit_observation: Synthetic DENY cross-owner grant cases; no live cross DB writes blocked in PostgreSQL

invariants.title: Redis is ephemeral
invariants.frozen_requirement: Redis contains no irreplaceable business truth.
invariants.future_test: Redis flushed/unavailable does not lose committed domain or critical event intent
invariants.audit_observation: Redis-loss replay is fixture; no real Redis outage test

invariants.title: Premium Hosting role
invariants.frozen_requirement: Premium Web Hosting is the LMS public asset origin, not the application core.
invariants.future_test: Static assets served from Premium Hosting, not running app core
invariants.audit_observation: Premium asset-origin placement frozen; runtime delivery not checked

invariants.title: Frontend delivery
invariants.frozen_requirement: Cloudflare Pages is the target delivery platform for learner and admin LMS frontends.
invariants.future_test: Learner/admin Cloudflare Pages independent build and deploy
invariants.audit_observation: Frontend Cloudflare status observed but admin separate build/deploy unverified

invariants.title: No KVM1 LLM inference
invariants.frozen_requirement: The current VPS must not run local LLM inference.
invariants.future_test: VPS process inventory excludes local LLM; provider budget/authorization
invariants.audit_observation: No LMS local-LLM source introduced; VPS process inventory not run

invariants.title: Cloudflare is not truth
invariants.frozen_requirement: Cloudflare edge/cache is not a canonical business-state store.
invariants.future_test: Purge caches and rebuild without losing canonical catalog or learner DB state
invariants.audit_observation: Cache not canonical per contract; no cache purge recovery run

invariants.title: Minimal VPS public ingress
invariants.frozen_requirement: Only explicitly required public ingress is exposed; internal data/services remain private.
invariants.future_test: Public ingress TLS/UFW probe allows only approved listeners
invariants.audit_observation: Private ingress rule frozen, no TLS/UFW/port inventory in this audit

invariants.title: Immutable asset strategy
invariants.frozen_requirement: Public LMS asset releases are versioned/immutable wherever practical.
invariants.future_test: Pinned jsDelivr/public artifacts retain immutability, alias rollback
invariants.audit_observation: Deterministic manifest hash in FE CI; immutable CDN release/rollback absent

invariants.title: Versioned API contract
invariants.frozen_requirement: Public backend APIs are versioned.
invariants.future_test: OpenAPI route inventory enforces /api/v1 versioned API
invariants.audit_observation: Versioned /api/v1 26 operations validated at pinned source

invariants.title: Complexity must be justified
invariants.frozen_requirement: New infrastructure is introduced only after a measurable or contractual requirement exists.
invariants.future_test: Resource-cost ADR and measured load justify any added infra
invariants.audit_observation: No new infrastructure deploy performed; resource cost/throughput ADR unmeasured

invariants.title: Gateway is ingress, not domain owner
invariants.frozen_requirement: The Gateway owns public API ingress behavior and no default business database.
invariants.future_test: Gateway routes and authorization only, no domain persistence database
invariants.audit_observation: Gateway owns ingress contract only; real route forwarding/server DB ownership not runtime-checked

invariants.title: Static Content Catalog remains canonical initially
invariants.frozen_requirement: Course/module/lesson/path/resource content remains source-controlled for the initial architecture.
invariants.future_test: Pinned Git compiled immutable catalog; no runtime canonical content DB
invariants.audit_observation: Static Git catalog, 31 immutable registry and published-only staging tested

invariants.title: Learning Service owns learner state
invariants.frozen_requirement: Enrollment, progress, completion, and bookmarks belong to Learning Service.
invariants.future_test: Learning-only durable enrollment/progress/completion/bookmark tests against catalog revision
invariants.audit_observation: Learning tables/grants/event ownership specified; durable Learning endpoints pending

invariants.title: Mentorship Service owns mentorship state
invariants.frozen_requirement: Offering, availability, booking, and session lifecycle belong to Mentorship Service.
invariants.future_test: Mentorship DB booking/slot uniqueness, idempotency, availability/session tests
invariants.audit_observation: Mentorship tables, booking slots, idempotency specified; real transactions pending

invariants.title: Knowledge Service owns derived searchable state
invariants.frozen_requirement: Knowledge indexes are rebuildable and non-canonical.
invariants.future_test: Derived indexes rebuild, staged publish and ACL enforcement tests
invariants.audit_observation: Knowledge derived indexes/checkpoint contract; rebuild and ACL untested

invariants.title: Assistant is orchestration only
invariants.frozen_requirement: Assistant Service never becomes canonical business state authority.
invariants.future_test: Assistant tool cannot become owner of domain writes or source canon; permission tests
invariants.audit_observation: Assistant orchestration-only policy; no AI domain mutation handler yet

invariants.title: Audit is durable and append-only
invariants.frozen_requirement: Privileged LMS actions requiring accountability are persisted by Audit Service.
invariants.future_test: Append-only Audit + admin operation intent and recovery
invariants.audit_observation: Audit append-only + role reconciliation candidate; DB enforced immutability absent

invariants.title: Keycloak remains identity authority
invariants.frozen_requirement: The LMS does not create a competing credential/identity store.
invariants.future_test: OIDC subject bound to Keycloak; no independent LMS passwords/users
invariants.audit_observation: Keycloak issuer/canonical identity contract; no live client provisioning

invariants.title: Separate browser clients
invariants.frozen_requirement: `lms-user` and `lms-admin` are separate OIDC public-client trust contexts.
invariants.future_test: Separate lms-user/lms-admin login context, admin origin checks
invariants.audit_observation: lms-user/admin two clients in trust fixture; runtime segregation untested

invariants.title: LMS API is the protected resource
invariants.frozen_requirement: Backend tokens target the `lms-api` audience.
invariants.future_test: Wrong audience accepted? Must reject; valid access token targets lms-api
invariants.audit_observation: aud lms-api deny mismatch modeled; real JWT verifier absent

invariants.title: Capability-based authorization
invariants.frozen_requirement: Backend operations authorize capabilities, not merely frontend persona labels.
invariants.future_test: Per-route authorized capability + principal ownership; no persona bypass
invariants.audit_observation: 19 capability names + operation bindings tested; no actual middleware authorization

invariants.title: No backend fallback-to-student authorization
invariants.frozen_requirement: Missing capability claims fail closed.
invariants.future_test: Missing claim results 401/403 fail-closed, no student default
invariants.audit_observation: Fail-closed missing claims negative mock; no production authorization proof

invariants.title: One public API version namespace
invariants.frozen_requirement: Initial business API surface uses `/api/v1`.
invariants.future_test: All 26 frozen endpoints covered by versioned /api/v1 schema; no invented routes
invariants.audit_observation: 26 frozen /api/v1 operations exact; no extra public family on branch diff

invariants.title: No direct public microservice exposure
invariants.frozen_requirement: Clients call only `lms-api.reltroner.com`.
invariants.future_test: Network/service caller negatives prevent direct browser access to domain apps
invariants.audit_observation: Gateway only external hostname in OpenAPI; actual network exposure untested

invariants.title: No cross-service database writes
invariants.frozen_requirement: Service ownership is enforced at database-credential level.
invariants.future_test: Scoped DB user privilege denies cross-service UPDATE/INSERT
invariants.audit_observation: DENY cross DB spec/fixture model; PG credential isolation untested

invariants.title: No distributed DB transactions
invariants.frozen_requirement: Cross-service consistency uses explicit calls/events/compensation.
invariants.future_test: No cross-DB transaction; outbox/idempotency/reconciliation under failure
invariants.audit_observation: Single-owner transaction/outbox/reconciliation contracts; no distributed txn run

invariants.title: Durable event intent uses outbox
invariants.frozen_requirement: Redis transport is not the only copy of correctness-critical event intent.
invariants.future_test: Atomic local outbox and consumer inbox survive broker duplication/crashes
invariants.audit_observation: Outbox/inbox events defined, fixture replay expected result hardcoded

invariants.title: Public search stays static where possible
invariants.frozen_requirement: Public catalog search does not require backend runtime dependency.
invariants.future_test: Public static search build excludes draft/private records; no backend dependency
invariants.audit_observation: Public search index uses published source allowlists, FE build privacy scanner green

invariants.title: Permission-aware search goes through Knowledge Service
invariants.frozen_requirement: Private/authorized search is backend-enforced.
invariants.future_test: Private search checks ACL before data/snippet/citation; stale rights fail closed
invariants.audit_observation: Private Knowledge search ACL denial modeled, no server result/snippet gate

invariants.title: Assistant mutation uses domain APIs
invariants.frozen_requirement: AI can never bypass service invariants.
invariants.future_test: All Assistant mutations invoke authorized domain APIs via validated delegation
invariants.audit_observation: Signed delegation + capability intersection contract, no runtime Assistant domain API calls

invariants.title: Initial Assistant is authenticated-only
invariants.frozen_requirement: Guest AI requires a later cost/abuse contract.
invariants.future_test: Guest Assistant calls denied; bounded authenticated AI provider usage
invariants.audit_observation: Guest Assistant denied by initial OpenAPI model, no running provider or abuse controls

invariants.title: No browser-native canonical content CRUD initially
invariants.frozen_requirement: Admin presence does not move source-controlled course authority into a runtime database.
invariants.future_test: No public browser-native lesson/course CRUD; source-controlled release only
invariants.audit_observation: No browser content CRUD in 26 routes; Git frontend remains source canon

invariants.title: Instructor uses admin plane
invariants.frozen_requirement: Privileged instructor workflows use `lms-admin.reltroner.com`, not a third frontend hostname.
invariants.future_test: Instructor privileged flows routed via lms-admin, no third origin
invariants.audit_observation: Instructor admin-plane intent in frozen contract, no tested instructor runtime path

invariants.title: Identity copies are projections only
invariants.frozen_requirement: `sub` is the principal reference; copied identity attributes are not authoritative.
invariants.future_test: Business state keyed on signed sub, copied identity fields not authoritative
invariants.audit_observation: OIDC sub + signed delegated principal designed; no durable subject-binding provider tested
